newsitem.title: USA: May Department January same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: May Department January same store sales up.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Thursday its same store sales for January rose 6.7 percent.
Total sales for the month gained 12.8 percent to $578.4 million from $512.9 million a year ago.
For the 52-week period ended February 1, same store sales rose 4.3 percent. Total sales for that period gained 11.1 percent to $11.65 billion from $10.48 billion.

Sales have been restated to exclude sales of stores that were closed and not replaced. Revenues, including sales of non-replaced closed stores and finance charge revenue, were $12.0 billion in fiscal 1996 and $10.84 billion in the 52-week period of fiscal 1995.
May said it opened 28 new department stores in fiscal 1996, 13 of which were acquired. It operates 365 department stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
